summary: Retrieve zero-padded pure-numeric RFI references through a bounded identifier-aware local search.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The parser canonicalizes RFI 0042 to RFI 42 but project-question retrieval did not
A 161-row fixture returned an unrelated row numbered 42 and omitted the final RFI 0042 reference
The full gate exposed two legacy context packs that duplicated growing product-wide documents and exceeded their fixed limits
approval_evidence: The user's persistent objective explicitly authorizes continued efficiency, accuracy and multi-content adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: Only an explicitly written pure-numeric RFI identifier receives leading-zero equivalence; prefixed, compound and Submittal identifiers remain exact by design.
The local supplement is capped at 24 complete phrase variants and 12 candidates, so exotic very-long zero padding may still rely on the ordinary or complete-scan path.
Synthetic offline retrieval does not establish construction accuracy, contractual authority or customer-corpus latency.
